fair_value_reason: 2028E non-GAAP EPS of ~$13.4 (FY27 consensus $12.09 less ~1.5-2% for the EUP and coverage, grown ~13%) x ~31x NTM with the 10-year at 5.29% gives ~$415, less a ~$5/share litigation haircut, gives ~$410. Cross-checked against a DCF at an ~8.75% WACC (~$380), the reconciled value is ~$405 on ~355M diluted shares. This is down from round 1's $420 because the 10-year is ~30bp higher than round 1 used.

thesis_triggers.event: Four of five agents hold $300, about 22x 2028E EPS and ~9% below the $328.57 July 2026 low. A rates-only de-rating to 25-26x would stop near $335-345. A close at $300 would most likely mean fundamental damage: a 2027 procedure guide below ~11%, an EUP drag well beyond 3% of I&A/procedure, an adverse turn in the hospital class case (trial 2027-09-14), or visible share loss to Ottava or Hugo.

supervisor_summary: In round 2 the five forecasts converged tightly: P(close >= $401 on 2027-10-01) is 0.49-0.55 (mean 0.51), fair values are $396-425 (mean ~$406), and four of five set the thesis break at $300. My checks confirmed the inputs they now share: the 10-year at 5.29% on Sep 30 (FRED, correcting round 1's stale ~5.0%), an EUP 2.0 limited to a subset of benign-procedure instruments, Hugo general-surgery clearance still pending, and the Q3 print on Oct 20. I found nothing that justifies moving off the mean ladder, so confidence is low and the mean should stand. The Oct 20 EUP quantification and the January 2027 procedure guide are the binaries that will move this name.
key_drivers: EUP 2.0 sizing on the 2026-10-20 call. The program covers a subset of instruments for high-volume benign procedures and excludes stapling, energy and force feedback; the plausible 2027 range is a 1-3% I&A/procedure drag (the 2020 program netted ~-1% over 2019-21 in the 10-K data).

US procedure growth (12% in Q2) against the ACA attrition in HCA's Q2 10-Q (uninsured admissions +23.4%, exchange admissions -15%, outpatient surgeries -3.4%), with Medicaid work requirements from 2027-01-01; the 2027 guide comes in January.
Rates: the 10-year rose from 4.79% to 5.29% in September 2026 (FRED) after the 2026-09-16 Fed hike, capping the multiple near 30.5-31.5x NTM.
Litigation: the Ninth Circuit SIS reversal (2026-08-13) and the hospital class trial on 2027-09-14, inside the horizon; a ~$5/share expected-value haircut and a fatter left tail.
Competition: Ottava (De Novo 2026-07-22, limited launch) and Hugo (general-surgery 510(k)s pending) weigh on the multiple more than on 2027 EPS.
